validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml"
       xmlns:event="https://github.com/stateforward/scxml.rs/namespaces/event"
       version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="idle">
  <state id="idle" event:schema='{"type": "object"}'>
    <onentry>
      <event:schema/>
      <event:defer/>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="order" target="done" event:schma="true"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

primary.message: an `event` attribute on an element that handles or creates no event data

notes: the `event` vocabulary describes event data only on `<transition>`, `<send>`, `<raise>`, or `<donedata>`: the `_event.data` a transition handles, the data a `<send>` or `<raise>` creates its event with, or the data of the `done.state.<id>` event of a `<donedata>`
diagnostics.help: move the attribute to `<transition>`, `<send>`, `<raise>`, or `<donedata>`, or remove it

diagnostics.message: `<event:schema>` is not an element of the `event` vocabulary

primary.message: not an element of any vocabulary

notes: `https://github.com/stateforward/scxml.rs/namespaces/event` has one element, `<event:defer/>` in a transition's content, which holds the event the transition handles; `event:schema` or `event:schemaexpr` on `<transition>`, `<send>`, `<raise>`, or `<donedata>` describes the event data the element handles or creates
diagnostics.help: remove the element, and describe the event data with an `event:schema` attribute on the element that handles or creates it

diagnostics.message: `<event:defer>` is only allowed in the content of a `<transition>` with an `event` attribute

primary.message: no event here for it to hold

notes: `<event:defer/>` holds the event the transition handles until the transition's state is exited or a state inside it that handles the event is entered; it is executable content of a `<transition event>` (directly or inside its `<if>` and `<foreach>`) only
diagnostics.help: move it into the transition that handles the event to hold, or remove it

diagnostics.message: `event:schma` is not an attribute of the `event` vocabulary
notes: the `event` vocabulary has exactly two attributes: `event:schema` (a JSON Schema, inline or by reference) and `event:schemaexpr` (an expression whose value is the schema)
